items.title: Día de los Muertos Drag Brunch
items.summary: Celebrate Día de los Muertos with an unforgettable afternoon of culture, entertainment, and community! Experience a spectacular live show featuring an incredible lineup of drag performers, including internationally acclaimed artists, fan favourites from the Drag Race franchise, and some of Canada's most celebrated drag talent. Enjoy dazzling performances, vibrant mariachi music, and a festive atmosphere that honours tradition through art, music, and self-expression.

items.title: River Mouth IV: The 4th Dimension
items.summary: River Mouth IV: The 4th Dimension brings the bars, beats, and energy to Mississauga for one massive night of hip-hop culture. Headlined by hometown heavyweights The Indestructible RUNXGUN , the night features explosive live performances from artists across the GTA, exclusive debuts of brand-new music recorded at Metalworks Studios, and the return of the high-stakes River Mouth Cypher , where elite MCs battle for bragging rights and a cash prize.

items.title: The Perfect Bite
items.summary: The Perfect Bite , presented by Secret City in collaboration with Netflix , brings its sold-out murder mystery dinner experience to Mississauga, inspired by the thrilling world of Netflix's Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery. Step into an exclusive culinary event hosted by acclaimed Chef Maribelle Moore , where a delicious four-course meal quickly becomes the scene of a gripping mystery . Interact with live actors, uncover secrets, and become part of the story as the evening unfolds around you.

items.title: Bring Your Own Craft Club
items.summary: Need some creative company? Come by our Bring Your Own Craft Club to connect with fellow makers and get a boost of motivation. Spend an afternoon socializing and tackling those unfinished projects. Come meet us at the Small Arms Building (in the south west corner at the blue couches across from the garage door by the main entrance, picture below) and enjoy the company of other crafters. Don’t have a project started yet?

items.title: The Credits 2026: An Evening of Regency Elegance
items.summary: Heritage Mississauga invites the community to The Credits 2026: An Evening of Regency Elegance , its annual awards gala celebrating the individuals, organizations, artists, and community leaders who contribute to shaping Mississauga’s story. Inspired by the world of Jane Austen and Bridgerton , the elegant evening will feature fine dining, entertainment, and the presentation of Heritage Mississauga’s prestigious Heritage Hero Awards .

items.title: Illuminating the Stories of WWII: Movie Screening and Sculpture Talk
items.summary: This Remembrance Day celebrate and reflect on the history, sacrifices and personal stories of Canadian soldiers and of Dutch civilians during the liberation of the Netherlands in World War II. Come enjoy this multifaceted evening, which includes a photo display, film screening and informative talk. Five photographs by Jason Van Bruggen from the 80 Years of Freedom Exhibition will be on view during this event. There will also be a screening of the film 80 Faces of Liberation also by Jason van Bruggen.
